query: (Cathay MD) Build a model to organise/optimise routes and service so Overall Rating > 7.

per_column.name: cabin_crew_service_quality
per_column.rationale: Categorical assessment of crew service extracted from review text; a plausible driver of satisfaction that lies outside the overall rating and is not a deterministic function of it. Overlaps with existing Staff Service but adds granularity.

per_column.name: crew_absence_pattern
per_column.rationale: Behavioral detail about crew responsiveness; an operational feature outside the focus that plausibly correlates with satisfaction and is not a restatement of the overall rating.

per_column.name: food_quality_rating
per_column.rationale: Qualitative food assessment; a plausible predictor of overall satisfaction, external to the focus. Partially redundant with the existing Food & Beverages column but still legitimate signal.

per_column.name: special_meal_handling
per_column.rationale: Boolean about special-meal handling; an operational service attribute outside the focus that could carry modest predictive signal, though sparsely populated (only 26 true).

per_column.name: baggage_handling_outcome
per_column.rationale: Outcome of baggage handling (lost/damaged/no issue); a service-failure feature distinct from the overall rating and plausibly predictive of low satisfaction.

per_column.name: haul_category
per_column.rationale: Flight duration bucket derived from route; a structural feature external to the focus that plausibly relates to comfort and satisfaction. Directly relevant to route optimization intent.

per_column.name: outstation_region
per_column.rationale: Geographic region of the route; an external structural predictor relevant to the route-organization query and plausibly correlated with satisfaction patterns.

per_column.name: premium_economy_product_gap
per_column.rationale: Flag indicating a product shortfall in premium economy; an external service-quality feature that plausibly predicts lower satisfaction, not a restatement of the overall rating.

judge.rationale: All eight added columns are legitimate predictors: they lie outside the focus variable, none deterministically restate or leak the overall rating, and each plausibly carries satisfaction signal. Several (cabin_crew_service_quality, food_quality_rating) overlap semantically with existing rating sub-scores, capping the marginal leverage, and several are sparse or heavily NULL (crew_absence_pattern, baggage_handling_outcome, special_meal_handling). The structural route features (haul_category, outstation_region) are the most novel and directly aligned with the route-optimization intent, adding genuine incremental signal. As a set they provide moderate predictive leverage beyond the original columns.
